memories.content: The calibration committee reviews promotion cases and decides whether to approve them. They have no prior knowledge of Jonas's case.

Promotion letters are scheduled to go out on November 15. The promotion process requires calibration committee approval followed by VP sign-off. Rosa Maria can submit Jonas's promotion case to the calibration committee. The committee may approve or reject the case; if approved, it goes to the VP for sign-off.
